title: MoDL: Model Based Deep Learning Architecture for Inverse Problems
layout_note: Three captioned sub-figures stacked top to bottom: (a) the denoiser's inside (Conv-BN-ReLU layers repeated N times with a red residual skip to a circled plus), (b) the method as a compact loop — denoiser box then data-consistency box with an 'Iterate' arrow returning beneath — and (c) the same loop unrolled into K iteration frames in a row.
grouping: Colour families carry identity across sub-figures: the denoiser is a pale yellow box in (b) and (c) and a yellow outer panel in (a); the data-consistency layer is mint in (b) and (c); the inner CNN body and the 'Shared Weights W' box share a tan/salmon tint. In (c) each iteration is a thin red-outlined square frame titled '1st Iteration', 'kth Iteration', 'Kth Iteration'.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered boxes without outlines in (b)/(c), small cyan layer boxes on grey-teal columns in (a); a grey-filled circled plus for the residual sum. No images or tensors: variables (x0 = A^H b, z_k, x_{k+1}) sit as math labels on arrows, and the data-consistency box holds its closed-form operator (A^H A + λI)^{-1}.
proposed_highlight: The two learned/model parts are named inside their boxes with math symbols (D_w = I - N_w, CNN-based Denoiser; Conjugate Gradient DC Layer), and weight sharing is made explicit by one tan 'Shared Weights W' box below the unrolled row with arrows rising into every denoiser.
lesson: Draw the method twice: as a compact two-box loop with an 'Iterate' return arrow, then unrolled into K red-framed iterations whose denoisers all take arrows from one 'Shared Weights' box beneath.
notes: venue IEEE TMI from the arXiv comment ('published in IEEE Transaction on Medical Imaging'); year = arXiv preprint year (1712.02862). Box labels are sans; math is set in a serif/calligraphic face (D_w, N_w, DC).

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

taxonomy.task: model-based deep learning for MRI reconstruction

insights.structure: Three captioned sub-figures stacked top to bottom: (a) the residual denoiser D_w as a yellow frame around a tan N_w block of Conv/BN/ReLU layers, (b) the compact two-box loop of yellow denoiser and green CG data-consistency layer, (c) the same loop unrolled into K red-framed iterations.
insights.data: Signals are math labels on arrows (x_0 = A^H b, z_k, x_{k+1}); layers are small teal boxes stacked in dark grey layer columns; the DC block shows the formula (A^H A + lambda I)^{-1}.
insights.emphasis: The colour pairing yellow = denoiser and green = data consistency is kept across (b) and (c), and a single tan 'Shared Weights W' box below (c) sends arrows up into every denoiser.
insights.flow: Each panel reads left to right; (b) has an 'Iterate' arrow looping back along the bottom, and in (c) a line from x_0 runs along the top into every DC block.
insights.avoid: The red iteration frames in (c) and the red skip line in (a) use red only for grouping, which competes with the emphasis colours.

arrangement.units: three captioned sub-figures stacked vertically, each a different zoom level (module, loop, unrolled); in (c) one red frame per iteration
arrangement.inputs_as: math label x_0 = A^H b on an incoming arrow
arrangement.shared: one 'Shared Weights W' box below the unrolled iterations with an arrow to each denoiser copy
